Joseph Conrad and Ford Madox Ford, The Nature of a Crime.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/joseph-conrad_ford-madox-ford/the-nature-of-a-crime

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Joseph Conrad, the author and writer of the preface, died 1924 (Wikidata Q82925, P570 = 1924-08-03).
- Ford Madox Ford, the author and writer of the preface, died 1939 (Wikidata Q537112, P570 = 1939-06-26).

First publication of the text used: 1909 (SE colophon: 'The Nature of a Crime was published in 1909 by Joseph Conrad and Ford Madox Ford').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1909, before 1931, so it is in the public domain in the United States. The edition's statement of rights below says the same.
- Other countries: the text is in English, and no fact names another country of first publication. The possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa. Each has a term of life + 70 years or less. The last person to die among the people whose words are in the text died in 1939, so the text is public domain in each of them.
